document.title: Keep size guidance general
document.summary: A new contract that later groups depend on stays large when those groups merge. The project rule keeps this repo's layers out of skill examples.
document.why: [The eval](source:s1) scored a new contract medium when its groups were merged. The size rule has to say that for any repository.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 26
sources.gist: comprehende-47 was medium with four groups. The size example must not name this repo's checks, UI, or instructions.

groups.title: Size stays large when groups merge
groups.why: [Four groups](source:s1) were scored medium. The same contract with more groups was large.
groups.summary: `skills-next` says a contract later groups depend on is large, and the `.agents` copy is identical.

commits.subject: Skill: a cross-layer contract stays large when groups merge
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Size was optional ("can be large") and tied to a three-file example, so a sources contract plus its checks, UI, and skill landed on medium whenever the producer merged those layers into four groups.
